company.name: beXel
company.shortDescription: Bexel is a software company that helps inspection companies digitize their entire inspection process, go paperless.
company.description: beXel is a cloud-based software that helps inspection companies digitize their entire inspection process, go paperless, practicing social distancing, and save inspection team time by completing tasks 10X faster. What makes our solution unique is that it's dynamic and industry compatible; simply put, if you generate many certificates or checklists for inspection or other purposes, beXel is you’re good to go solution.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $712,562 to $4,767,956, a 6.69x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 60 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 71 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
